strings.jp: こやつら・・・、案外やりおるぞ！
strings.en: These brats... They're better than I thought, eh!

strings.jp: この調子なら、悲願であった・・・
strings.en: At this rate, my dearest wish...

strings.jp:
戦場での死を
むかえられるやもしれん・・・！！
strings.en: ...a death on the battlefield, may yet come to me...!!

strings.jp: 面白い・・・・
strings.en: How amusing....

strings.jp:
こんなに暇をつぶせたのは、
ひさしぶりじゃ！！
strings.en: I haven't killed time this well in ages, my boy!!

strings.jp:
なっ！
なんだこの爺さん達は！？、
strings.en: Wh-! What is with these old men!?
Th... they're strong as hell...!!

strings.jp: タダのジジイと見くびるでないわ！
strings.en: Don't you look down on us as mere geezers!

strings.jp: ココにいるわし等は皆・・・
strings.en: Every one of us here, my boy...

strings.jp:
その昔は戦場を駆けめぐった
歴戦の勇士ばかりじゃ！！
strings.en: ...is a seasoned hero who once ranged across the battlefields!!

strings.jp:
ひよっ子共には・・・
まだまだ殺られはせんて！！
strings.en: We won't be killed by fledglings like you just yet, eh!!

strings.jp: おい！俺達は・・・
strings.en: Hey! We're...

strings.jp: この村の人間じゃ無っ・・・！
strings.en: ...not from this vill--...!

strings.jp: 百も承知！！
strings.en: We know that full well!!

strings.jp:
そのような事を
気にしていられるほど
わし等の村は悠長な状態では無い！
strings.en: Our village is in no state to go fretting over such things!

strings.jp: とにかく若者を・・・
strings.en: The thing is, young folk...

strings.jp: 若者を集めねば村が崩壊し・・・
strings.en: We must gather young folk, or the village will collapse...

strings.jp: せっかく創ったわし等の楽園が・・・
strings.en: ...and the paradise we worked so hard to build...

strings.jp: お主達も少しは落ち着け！！
strings.en: You lot settle down a little as well, eh!!

strings.jp: なんじゃお前は！
strings.en: And what's with you!

strings.jp:
ジジイならジジイらしく・・・
ジジイの味方をせんか！！
strings.en: If you're a geezer, act like one... and take the geezers' side, blast it!!

strings.jp: 失礼しちゃうわ！！
strings.en: How rude!!

strings.jp:
ヨハネ様は
アナタ達ほど
ジジイじゃありませんことよ！
strings.en: Johannes-sama is not nearly the geezer you lot are, I'll have you know!
